description: This file contains unit tests for the class BaseOpenmrsObject and its subclasses within the OpenMRS project. It tests equality, hash code, and string representations, as well as interactions with Hibernate proxies. The tests ensure correct behavior of object comparison logic in various scenarios.

classes.name: BaseOpenmrsObjectMock
classes.description: A mock subclass of BaseOpenmrsObject used for testing, overriding getId and setId methods.

classes.name: TestClass
classes.description: A nonHibernate managed class extending BaseOpenmrsObject, used in various equality tests.

classes.name: AnotherTestClass
classes.description: Another nonHibernate class extending BaseOpenmrsObject, used for cross-class equality testing.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenObjHasNullUuid
methods.description: Tests that equals returns false when the compared object's UUID is null.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenObjIsNotInstanceOfBaseOpenmrsObject
methods.description: Tests that equals returns false when the given object is not an instance of BaseOpenmrsObject.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenObjIsNull
methods.description: Tests that equals returns false when comparing to null.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnFalseIfUuidIsNull
methods.description: Tests that equals returns false when the calling object's UUID is null.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnTrueIfObjectsAreTheSame
methods.description: Tests that equals returns true when comparing the object to itself.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnTrueIfUuidsAreEqual
methods.description: Tests that equals returns true when the UUIDs of both objects are equal.

methods.name: hashCode_shouldNotFailIfUuidIsNull
methods.description: Ensures hashCode does not throw an exception when UUID is null.

methods.name: shouldNotBeEqualWhenDifferentClassesAndSameId
methods.description: Tests that objects of different classes with the same ID are not equal.

methods.name: shouldNotBeEqualWhenFirstIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that an object does not equal null.

methods.name: toString_shouldIncludeUuidIfNotNull
methods.description: Verifies toString output includes UUID if it's not null.

methods.name: toString_shouldIncludeHashCodeIfUuidIsNull
methods.description: Verifies toString output includes hash code and '<null>' UUID if UUID is null.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenObjectIsInstanceOfSuperOrExtendingClass
methods.description: Tests equality when comparing a subclass instance with its superclass.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenObjIsNotInstanceOfSuperOrExtendingClass
methods.description: Verifies that objects of different classes are not equal.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenObjectIsSubclassOfSuperOrExtendingClass
methods.description: Tests equality when comparing subclasses of the same base class.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenObjectIsNotSubclassOfSuperOrExtendingClass
methods.description: Verifies that objects of unrelated classes are not equal.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnfalseIfHibernateProxyOfOneThingIsComparedtoHibernateProxyofSomething
methods.description: Tests that different Hibernate proxies of different classes do not equal each other.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnFalseIfHibernateProxyOfOneThingIsComparedtoNonHibernateProxyofSomething
methods.description: Checks that a Hibernate proxy does not equal a non-proxy object of a different class.

methods.name: equals_shouldWorkOnNonHibernateManagedClasses
methods.description: Tests equality logic for classes not managed by Hibernate, including cross-class comparisons.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnTrueIfHibernateProxyOfOneObjectComparedToNonHibernateProxyOfTheSameObject
methods.description: Verifies proxy vs non-proxy equality for the same singleton object.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnTrueIfHibernateProxyOfSomeObjectComparedToAnotherHibernateProxyOfTheSameObject
methods.description: Ensures that two proxies of the same entity are considered equal.
